verdict.rationale: Any service that collects filer data could publish a policy or opt-out on AI-training use, so this axis applies to a state business-filing service. Nothing in the evidence pack addresses AI-training data use, an opt-out, or a related privacy control. The Business Express robots.txt 'Disallow: /' governs crawler access to the portal, not the use of a user's submitted data, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
